base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: I2S is a wire-level audio streaming protocol; no register map at the protocol layer. Concrete I2S controller / target IP blocks define their own register file (typically: TX/RX FIFO control, sample rate / bit clock divisor, word length, channel-format select, mute, interrupt enable) at the SoC integration level — covered by individual block guides, not by UM11732.
